controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM .internal.alerts-security.alerts-default-*
| WHERE host.name == "db-1"
        AND @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T18:35:57.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T19:35:57.000Z"
| STATS events = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY kibana.alert.rule.name
| SORT events DESC
